instruction: Look at clamp_input.dxf. Draw a C-clamp outline by connecting vertices (0,0), (130,0), (130,25), (35,25), (35,85), (130,85), (130,110), and (0,110) in order on layer OUTLINE. Add a screw clearance through-hole circle centered at (105,55) with radius 10 on layer HOLE, add a CENTER line from (35,55) to (130,55), and add text ACAD-17 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
